### `-w`/`--watch`

Rebuild the bundle when its source files change on disk.

_Note: While in watch mode, the `ROLLUP_WATCH` environment variable will be set to `"true"` by Rollup's command line interface and can be checked by other processes. Plugins should instead check [`this.meta.watchMode`](../plugin-development/index.md#this-meta), which is independent of the command line interface._

### this.meta

|       |                                               |
| ----: | :-------------------------------------------- |
| Type: | `{rollupVersion: string, watchMode: boolean}` |

An object containing potentially useful Rollup metadata:

- `rollupVersion`: The currently running version of Rollup as define in `package.json`.
- `watchMode`: `true` if Rollup was started via `rollup.watch(...)` or from the command line with `--watch`, `false` otherwise.

`meta` is the only context property accessible from the [`options`](#options) hook.

Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
